messages.content: The Corpus team sent a gate map and rain note. Can you sanity-check Monday arrival to the hotel, parking, Tuesday 6:00 badge pickup, and Thursday airport timing? Don’t change the flights, car, or hotel unless something is actually tight.

Checked against the booked SFO-IAH-CRP itinerary, compact SUV, and Residence Inn bayfront. Monday still works: after CRP arrival, allow about 30 minutes for the rental counter and 15-20 minutes to the hotel, even with coastal rain.
For Tuesday, what time should I pull out?
Leave the hotel at 5:05 a.m. Best fit with rain buffer: arrive at the security trailer around 5:30-5:35 for badge pickup before the 6:00 walkdown. If rain is heavy, make it 4:55.
And Thursday after the 9:00-10:30 procurement meeting?

Keep the return. Leave the plant by 11:10-11:15, fuel near CRP, and return the car around 12:10 for the midafternoon flight through Houston. No reservation changes needed; just monitor the inbound Houston segment and check in when it opens.

messages.content: Switching gears to something personal. My wife and I are looking at Santa Fe for a Friday-to-Monday weekend, low-key. Can you compare flying into Santa Fe versus Albuquerque from the Bay Area, plus a car and a walkable, well-reviewed Plaza-area hotel?
Sure. Is this the April 17-20 weekend? And are you trying to start Friday afternoon, or is Saturday morning still on the table?
Yes, April 17 to 20. Friday afternoon would be better if the travel isn’t a mess. Saturday morning is the backup. I may have a Monday client call, but that’s not settled.
Got it. I’ll keep Monday flexible until that call clears. For airports, should I start with SFO only, or can I check Oakland and San Jose if they make Albuquerque easier?
Start with SFO. Oakland is acceptable if it saves a connection. I don’t want a two-stop itinerary for a weekend.

Flight picture: Santa Fe is convenient at the end but less clean. The best SAF option is SFO-DEN-SAF, leaving Friday about 1:45 p.m. and arriving around 7:20 p.m.; one connection, smaller last leg, and Denver weather exposure. Albuquerque is the reliability pick: nonstop SFO-ABQ around 3:30 p.m., arriving about 6:50 p.m., then a 60-70 minute drive north. Saturday backup is a morning ABQ nonstop, but it cuts a real chunk out of the weekend.
The ABQ nonstop sounds cleaner. Is the Friday drive reasonable after landing?

Yes, assuming you are comfortable getting to the hotel around 8:30-8:45 after bags and rental pickup. It is mostly interstate. I’d keep the car simple: compact is enough, midsize only if you want extra room for the drive.
Compact is fine. What hotels near the Plaza look like the best fit? Quiet room matters more than a fancy lobby.

Shortlist: Drury Plaza Hotel is the practical best fit: strong guest feedback, very walkable, on-site parking, and easy dinner options; I’d request an interior or higher-floor room away from elevators. Inn of the Governors is the acceptable quieter-feel backup: classic, walkable, well reviewed, but rooms can feel older. Hotel St. Francis has the most character and location, but smaller rooms and less convenient parking.
Any reason to fly into Santa Fe instead if we stay at Drury?

Only if avoiding the Albuquerque drive is the main goal. The SAF option still arrives later, depends on the Denver connection, and if the last leg slips you lose the evening anyway. ABQ nonstop plus compact car is the cleaner schedule.
Let’s not book yet. Hold the best Friday/Monday ABQ version and note the Saturday fallback until I know whether Monday is clear.

Held as best fit: Friday afternoon nonstop SFO-ABQ, compact car, Drury Plaza with a quiet-room request, and a Monday return timed after checkout and the drive back to ABQ. Acceptable backup: Saturday morning ABQ nonstop with the same hotel shortened if Friday gets squeezed. I’ll ask before booking once the Monday call is confirmed.

messages.content: Client call moved to Tuesday, so we can do the full Friday-to-Monday Santa Fe weekend. Let’s book the ABQ nonstop option, compact car, and Drury if it still looks like the best fit.

Still available. Friday SFO-ABQ nonstop departs 3:35 p.m. and arrives 6:55 p.m. Monday ABQ-SFO nonstop departs 4:20 p.m. and arrives 5:55 p.m. Drury Plaza has a refundable king room, and the compact car is available at ABQ. Want me to book those?
Yes. For the room, add quiet side if possible. We don’t need anything special beyond that.
Added the hotel note: quiet room, higher floor if available, away from elevator and ice machine. Parking is on site, and the Plaza plus several dinner spots are walkable.
Book it. And for seats, together matters more than window or aisle.
Booked. I selected adjacent standard seats: 18A/18B outbound and 17A/17B return, with no paid upgrades. If your wife would rather avoid the middle, I can watch for an aisle pair.
That’s okay. What’s the Friday timing?

Friday: arrive ABQ 6:55 p.m., pick up the compact car around 7:20, drive to Santa Fe, and reach Drury around 8:35-8:45. I left dinner unreserved; La Boca has a late slot if you want me to check before booking.
And Monday isn’t too tight?

Not tight. Checkout, have lunch, leave Santa Fe around 12:30, reach ABQ about 1:45, return the car, and still have roughly two hours before the 4:20 nonstop. Trip is booked: flights, compact car, Drury Plaza king room with quiet-room note, and adjacent seats.
